title: Santa-hat bat ornament
subtitle: Traced from your wall photo · 3 mm thick, hangs from a small black loop on top of the pom-pom · shown standing as it hangs · millimetres
scale_note: The size is a design choice: 100 mm across. The paper bats have no measured size. Tell me a size you'd like and I'll rescale it. The photo looks along the wall, so the bat appeared squashed sideways; it's stretched 1.23× to undo that (estimated from the round pom-pom).
notes_title: v2: what changed, what to check
notes: v2: no more hole through the pom-pom. It's a solid white ball again (7 mm), and the ornament hangs from a slim black loop on top of it (5 mm across, 2.6 mm hole), like the cap on a glass ornament. The loop sits straight above the pom-pom, so it still hangs level. Everything else is the same as v1: bat traced from your photo, hat drawn by hand, colours all the way through, brim + pom-pom 0.6 mm proud. Check: (1) do you like the loop? (2) is 100 mm the right size? (3) one colour or AMS multi-colour? (4) does the bat look as wide as your paper ones?
